760240601.text: I'm guessing the Weasel Thief Big Bosses are trying to copy the big guys and make the Moley family their flunkies.

760240602.text: But just like how those big guys failed, they probably didn't get their way either. Those weasels have messed up Moleyvalley, and now the Moley family are hiding in a hole somewhere.

760240604.text: Yeah, they're just Sniffer Moles... and it's not like the Weasel Thieves don't already have super dangerous weapons! ...Come to think of it, it's crazy they even *have* those.

760240607.text: Moleyvalley once again belongs to Grandpa Moley and his family. As we agreed, here's your Mora. Thanks for the help!

760240608.text: Oh, yeah. Might as well give you this as well. Helka said fiction mustn't find its way into her booklet, or it'll start getting hard to tell truth from falsehood.

760240609.text: I'm not sure it matters... Even false things contain some truth, don't they?

760240610.text: #Anyway, I'll see you around, {NICKNAME}, Littlest Miss Paimon. I'll come find you again if the Weasel Thief Big Bosses try anything funny.

760240611.text: #Hehe, looks like our reputation's a-growin', {NICKNAME}! Paimon really hopes those weasels don't try anything funny again. You take care, Auni!

760240612.text: I will. Safe travels, you two!

760240606.text: Well, these are just Sniffer Moles, after all... And if we look at this differently, the Weasel Thieves only got their hands on dangerous machines because of humans. It's only right that humans should clean up the mess that other humans created!

760240501.text: You're not sure what's going on, but you approach the little girl...

760240502.text: Watch out for those Weasel Thieves. They've been hanging out in Moleyvalley for a while now. If they get you, you'll become a person with no shadow, too.

760240503.text: Weasel Thieves? Where? Also, what do you mean, "person with no shadow"...?

760240504.text: Whoa! What's up with that machine? Are the Weasel Thieves using it to attack us?

760240505.text: Those ones were raised by humans — might even be smarter than humans, too. That's how they chased all the big guys away.

760240506.text: Now — and the big guys have tried and failed to do this before — you just have to <color=#00E1FFFF>remove the energy core</color>, and you're golden. They've never actually done it, though, so it can't be that easy.

760240507.text: #Hmm, we can stop the Weasel Thieves by grabbing the energy core, right? C'mon, {NICKNAME}, why don't we give it a go?

760240508.text: We can't just ignore something dangerous like that when there's a little kid running around.

760240509.text: Seeing as it's the great Paimon asking, I could never refuse!

760240510.text: Just keep your head down here, okay, lil' miss? ... Oh, right. What's your name again?

760240511.text: ...Aren't you the "littlest" miss here? I don't get it... Whatever, I'm Auni, and you should call me "Big Sis," littlest miss. It's only proper.

760240512.text: #Uhm... Let's just leave the titles aside for now... Come on, {NICKNAME}. We've got Weasel Thieves to bring down a peg or two!

760240101.text: Heh. It's the end of the line for you now!

760240102.text: Huh. This is my first time seeing the Weasel Thief Big Boss up close... Oh, yeah. You've gotta call him Big Boss too, Paimon!

760240115.text: Wha... Fat chance Paimon's gonna call some Weasel Thief "Big Boss"!

760240118.text: You're right. Bad kids can't be bosses, can they? And no one's going to attend their funerals either... if they even hold 'em.

760240132.text: Oh, right! I heard Helka say that there are strange people who eat strange meat, such as meat from Weasel Thieves. And there are those who like to collect specimens...

760240133.text: Whether eating them or collecting them, there won't be any need for a funeral afterward.

760240134.text: Whoa, Auni... Are you seriously saying all that scary stuff with a straight face?

760240137.text: Huh? It doesn't seem to be running... but waiting for us? Well, let's go see what's up.

760240201.text: #Wow, you were way stronger than those big guys, {NICKNAME}. I guess size isn't everything!

760240202.text: #Hehe, right? {NICKNAME}'s not the tallest person ever, but {M#he}{F#she} can thrash monsters ten times {M#his}{F#her} size, easy!

760240204.text: Eh—!? Umm, flattery won't get you... W—Well, it might get you... half Paimon's share next time we eat something nice, how's that sound?

760240206.text: #Then you can kick the Weasel Thief Big Bosses out of Moleyvalley, right, {NICKNAME}? This isn't their home, but they're always making a mess of it anyway.

760240207.text: Funerals that should have been held can't be, and Grandpa Moley might've gotten killed because of them, too. But if we're going to hold new funerals, we'll have to find all of them first.

760240208.text: Huh!? Did Weasel Thieves really... Also, can Paimon ask... When you say funerals, do you mean that people want to hold them here? Why here, of all places...

760240209.text: Of course they do. I've made all the preparations, and I've thought of what songs to sing, too. Here, have a look — but do be quiet. Let him rest quietly.

760240210.text: Auni takes a small matchbox from her pocket and opens it. A beautifully-colored beetle lies on a flowery lining cloth within. There are even a few white petals adorning the scene...

760240211.text: He's gone to his eternal rest, so we've got to hold a funeral for him. But all the places I picked are those small hills with machines on 'em, and they've all been occupied by Weasel Thieves.

760240212.text: If Grandpa Moley's family haven't fled by now, they're probably dead. That's how badly the Weasel Thieves destroyed their home.

760240213.text: #({NICKNAME}, do you think this "Grandpa Moley" guy she talks about is actually...)

760240301.text: Should we bury it by the sea, or on top of some small hill...?

760240401.text: Y'know, Paimon's just noticed that all the Weasel Thieves fled toward that little hill over there...

760240402.text: Yeah, and it's something the big guys who trained the Weasel Thieves brought over. The Weasel Thief Big Boss used it to beat the big guys up — sent them rolling and crawling!

760240406.text: #Aaanyway, let's go to that hill and investigate. Keep your eyes open for a Weasel Thief ambush, {NICKNAME} — Paimon would rather not roll... or crawl!

760240405.text: Wait, would you have wanted to help? ... No, you just want to watch the mess unfold!

760241003.text: Huh!? Seriously? They all ran!? And in different directions, too!

760241002.text: #{NICKNAME}, Auni, each of us gets one. Don't let 'em get away this time!

subQuests.subQuestName: Catch up with the Weasel Thief

760241501.text: Ooh, look! It's the whole Moley family. Grandpa, Papa, Mama, Lil' Moley, Little Lil' Moley... and all the rest.

760241502.text: Oh, so they're Sniffer Moles! Wait, how do you tell them apart? They all look the same to Paimon.

760241503.text: By their personalities, of course! You'll understand if you get to know 'em.

760241504.text: But they all have the same bad habit of begging for stuff from humans. *sigh* Poor critters. If we went extinct, what would happen to them?

760241505.text: ...Humans? Go extinct? While Sniffer Moles survive? H—How could that happen?

760241506.text: Big Sis Linnea says that animals go extinct for all sorts of reasons. That means humans can go extinct, too. How do you not know that, Littlest Miss Paimon?

760241508.text: But that doesn't really answer Auni's question, does it? Hmm... Come to think of it, humans really are in a scary spot with all these threats out there...

760241512.text: Anyway, back on topic — what're we going to do about these Weasel Thieves now that we've found our moles?

760241513.text: If no one's got a better idea, let's just hand them over to The Flagship...

760241514.text: Treasure! Or is it a bribe in this situation? Eh, whatever. Since they're giving it to us, we might as well take it.

760241515.text: #Well, they seem sorry, at least. Let's let 'em off the hook this time, {NICKNAME} — but not because they gave us treasure, of course!

760241510.text: And they'll probably still be around when we're gone.

760241511.text: Wait, so humans are gonna lose to insects? ... Ugh, Paimon's kinda peeved by that!

subQuests.subQuestName: Catch up with the Weasel Thief

760240701.text: Great. Everyone's still here, and no one's turned into a shadowless mole.

760240801.text: Oh, right. Still gotta hold that funeral. I wonder if I should invite the others from the Conch Gang...

760240803.text: Oh, would you like to join, too? If you do, Jurva's the guy to ask. He'll be at "Speranza." Though, if there's gonna be a vote, Helka's not around right now...

760240804.text: But that's fine. I'm sure Jurva will find a way.

760240806.text: I'd guess they started picking up human habits from living alongside us for so long. Weasel Thieves do this too — and so do the saurians in Natlan, or so I'm told.

760240807.text: I'm not sure if it's a good thing or a bad thing, though...

760241101.text: I just need a moment to get ready, then I'll catch him for sure...
